forms.name: Petrified Sword
forms.text:
Made using a fossil from the
Wycademy. The default Sword
and Shield for Bherna Hunters.

forms.name: Scholarly Sword
forms.text:
The Petrified Sword's final
form. A product of the
Wycademy's tireless research.

forms.name: Sophos Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Petrified Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Frost Edge
forms.text:
Made from Ice Crystals that
crystalized over a long period
of time and will not melt.

forms.name: Hi Frost Edge
forms.text:
The Frost Edge's final form.
The crystals accentuate its
sublime, eternal beauty.

forms.name: Permafrost Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Frost Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Velocidrome Bite
forms.text:
A powerful one-handed Sword
crafted from newly developed
techniques and materials.

forms.name: Velocidrome Fang
forms.text:
The Velocidrome Bite's final
form. Its crimson comb is
effective for intimidation.

forms.name: Velocidrome Fang Slash
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Velocidrome Bite</COL>.

forms.name: Spiked Circle
forms.text:
Twin snakes who each seek to
devour the other's gems -- a
symbol of the Najarala.

forms.name: Paraspiked Circle
forms.text:
The Spiked Circle's final
form houses an eternally
malicious Najarala spirit.

forms.name: Paraspiked Rondo
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Spiked Circle</COL>.

forms.name: Shura Fan
forms.text:
An attractive avian fan
that can prove to be
hypnotic in dances.

forms.name: Dream Duke Shura
forms.text:
The Shura Fan's final form.
Once hypnotized by it, you'll
never be able to wake up.

forms.name: Dream Archduke Shura
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shura Fan</COL>.

forms.name: Raven Blade
forms.text:
A jet black blade made from
Yian Garuga parts that can
cut through even steel.

forms.name: Wolf Blade
forms.text:
The Raven Blade's final
form. It feeds off of the
wielder's paranoia.

forms.name: Crow Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Raven Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Drome Rush Dagger
forms.text:
A weapon based on how
monsters' claws are used for
both attack and defense.

forms.name: Great Stabberdag
forms.text:
The Drome Rush Dagger's final form.
Lash out at enemies as a wild beast
would shred with its claws.

forms.name: Azure Drome Tooth
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Drome Rush Dagger</COL>.

forms.name: Hidden Edge
forms.text:
An ebon Sword, black as night.
The strange texture of its blade
is said to conceal bloodstains.

forms.name: Flash in the Night
forms.text:
The Hidden Edge's final
form. A timelessly fine
blade for dirty work.

forms.name: Avidya Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hidden Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Obsidian Sword
forms.text:
A sword forged from an ebon
fossil. Any Hunter would be
proud to own one.

forms.name: Lustrous Cretecia
forms.text:
The Obsidian Sword's final
form. As gorgeous as it is
effective in combat.

forms.name: Ethereal Cretecia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Obsidian Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Carapace Mace
forms.text:
A grim, cudgel-like Sword
made from a Barroth's shell.
It can shatter bone.

forms.name: Barroth Club
forms.text:
The Carapace Mace's final form.
Its destructive power surpasses
what should be possible.

forms.name: Pneumatic Drillblade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Carapace Mace</COL>.

forms.name: Dios Edge
forms.text:
A volatile Sword made of many
Brachydios parts. Anything it
touches explodes into bits.

forms.name: Booming Barrage
forms.text:
The Dios Edge's final form. Be
the envy of every hunter as you
catch the Guildmarm's eye.

forms.name: Thermostorm
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dios Edge</COL>.

forms.name: Demolition Cutter
forms.text:
A Sword embodying the savage
anger of the earth. Its explosive
power can sunder the sky.

forms.name: Struxion Demolisher
forms.text:
The Demolition Cutter's final
form. For those who like to have
a real blast hunting.

forms.name: Struxion Annihilator
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demolition Cutter</COL>.

forms.name: Lightbreak Sword
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield that stir
the earth with explosive
tirades, devouring all in sight.

forms.name: Lightbreak Ray
forms.text:
The Lightbreak Sword's final form.
Once it surpasses the critical point,
everything it touches will vaporize.

forms.name: Lightbreak Beam
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lightbreak Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Hunter's Knife
forms.text:
A simple, yet functional
Sword & Shield beloved
by Hunters for ages.

forms.name: Fighter Sword
forms.text:
The fully upgraded Hunter's
Knife looks the same, but
has never cut better.

forms.name: Champion's Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hunter's Knife</COL>.

forms.name: Soldier's Dagger
forms.text:
A light Sword crafted from
Jaggi materials. Easy to use
and widely available.

forms.name: Commander's Dagger
forms.text:
The fully upgraded Soldier's
Dagger strikes hard and fast,
a lot like a Jaggi.

forms.name: Elite Dagger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Soldier's Dagger</COL>.

forms.name: Princess Rapier
forms.text:
The latest entry in the
poison Sword line.
Reassuringly efficient.

forms.name: Queen Rapier
forms.text:
The Princess Rapier's final
form. Those struck by it shalt
well know their lowly place.

forms.name: Empress Rapier
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Princess Rapier</COL>.

forms.name: Lunatic Rose
forms.text:
The Sword of a noble queen who
braved the path of thorns,
leaving red flowers as testament.

forms.name: Lunatic Briar
forms.text:
The soul of the old, noble queen
of yore still burns as the Lunatic
Rose's final evolution.

forms.name: Lunatic Thorn
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lunatic Rose</COL>.

forms.name: Khezu Razor
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made of
Khezu parts, designed only
to inflict lots of pain.

forms.name: Painful Razor
forms.text:
The Khezu Razor's final form.
Cuts far too deeply for victims
to suppress their screams.

forms.name: Dread Razor
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Khezu Razor</COL>.

forms.name: Usurper's Firebolt
forms.text:
A Sword filled with the life
force of a king. Its strikes fall
like arcs of lightning.

forms.name: Despot's Crookbolt
forms.text:
The final upgrade of the
Usurper's Firebolt fries foes
to a fine, toasty crisp.

forms.name: Oppressor's Bounty
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Usurper's Firebolt</COL>.

forms.name: Serpent Bite
forms.text:
Powerful serpent blade made
from high quality Velociprey
materials.

forms.name: Serpent Cleaver
forms.text:
The Serpent Bite's final
form. Dragon scales aren't
a problem for these fangs.

forms.name: Serpent Soul
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Serpent Bite</COL>.

forms.name: Snake Bite
forms.text:
Made from Giaprey materials.
The more it's toiled over, the
stronger it becomes.

forms.name: Snowy Cleaver
forms.text:
The gorgeous scales on the
Snake Bite's final form make
death a little prettier.

forms.name: Asp Bite
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Snake Bite</COL>.

forms.name: Viper Bite
forms.text:
Upgraded serpent blade made
from Genprey parts. Contains
paralyzing Genprey Fang.

forms.name: Deathprize
forms.text:
The Viper Bite's final form.
It strikes with paralyzing blows
that disable foes with ease.

forms.name: Deathgrip
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Viper Bite</COL>.

forms.name: Hydra Bite
forms.text:
Upgraded serpent blade made
with Ioprey materials.
Contains poison Ioprey Fang.

forms.name: Deadly Poison
forms.text:
The Hydra Bite's final form.
If the rips and tears don't kill,
the poison will.

forms.name: Lethal Poison
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hydra Bite</COL>.

forms.name: Naab Sword
forms.text:
A Seregios scale Sword & Shield.
Evading repeatedly while drawn
restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Feral Fangs
forms.text:
Those that wield The Naab
Sword's final form lead
revolutions to victory.

forms.name: Insurgent Fangs
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Naab Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Seditious Fang
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield that shreds
prey. Evading repeatedly while
drawn restores some Sharpness.

forms.name: Panja Sedition
forms.text:
Cut your own path to glory
with the final form of the
Seditious Fang.

forms.name: Sedition Shredder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Seditious Fang</COL>.

forms.name: Hunter's Dagger
forms.text:
An oddly shaped sword that's
easy to use and cuts like
a sickle.

forms.name: Assassin's Dagger
forms.text:
In spite of its curved blade,
the final form of the Hunter's
Dagger is still sharp.

forms.name: Master's Dagger
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hunter's Dagger</COL>.

forms.name: Lava Pick
forms.text:
Resembling the Uroktor,
The beak-shaped blade
unleashes fiery strikes.

forms.name: Burly Beak
forms.text:
The Lava Pick's final
form. The Uroktor's soul
surges red hot within.

forms.name: Bruising Beak
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lava Pick</COL>.

forms.name: Dual Carapace
forms.text:
Sword made from two varieties
of shell with a strong Water
element solution coating.

forms.name: Dual Scissors
forms.text:
The Dual Carapace's final
form. Has a harder shield and
sharper sword.

forms.name: Dual Crustacio
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dual Carapace</COL>.

forms.name: Heavy Bang
forms.text:
Reminiscent of a Great Sword
due to the heavy ores used
to make it. Loved by many.

forms.name: Master Bang
forms.text:
The Heavy Bang's final form
has destructive power that
exceeds most of its class.

forms.name: Bang Bang
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Heavy Bang</COL>.

forms.name: Baumfäller
forms.text:
A Sword made from a horn wider
than a man's chest. One swing
can rend flesh and shatter bone.

forms.name: Dendrotomy
forms.text:
The Baumfäller's final form.
It strikes with the force of a
landslide.

forms.name: Plutocatena
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Baumfäller</COL>.

forms.name: Icicle Spike
forms.text:
A Sword of extreme cold.
Its blade can pierce shells to
freeze prey from the inside.

forms.name: Nardebosche
forms.text:
The Icicle Spike's final form. The
Barioth's avatar, in the form of a
platinum sword, silences the earth.

forms.name: Never Event
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Icicle Spike</COL>.

forms.name: Cryo Cross
forms.text:
A cruel Sword that reduces all
to oblivion. Said to have driven
the fire gods to their knees.

forms.name: Icestorm Cross
forms.text:
Cryo Cross's final form. Rare
is the creature who can
withstand its subzero sting.

forms.name: Glacio Cross
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cryo Cross</COL>.

forms.name: Odyssey Blade
forms.text:
Single bladed short sword
imbued with the power of
water to wash away blood.

forms.name: Master Odyssey
forms.text:
The Odyssey Blade's final
form. No matter the attack,
its blade never truly dulls.

forms.name: Agamemnon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Odyssey Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Kris
forms.text:
A simple and dependable bone
sword that's perfect for
beginning Hunters.

forms.name: Chief Kris
forms.text:
The Bone Kris's final form.
Not only is it solid, it
makes gathering easy.

forms.name: King Kris
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Kris</COL>.

forms.name: Ludroth's Nail
forms.text:
A Sword covered in Ludroth
hide. It seems capable of
even greater strength.

forms.name: Ludroth Gear
forms.text:
The Ludroth's Nail's final
form is made of skin tougher
than the monster's nails.

forms.name: Foaming Ludroth Gear
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ludroth's Nail</COL>.

forms.name: Royal Claw
forms.text:
A Sword made from Ludroth
materials. Its sprays of
water mesmerize monsters.

forms.name: Royal Ludroth Claw
forms.text:
The Royal Claw's final form
has a blade clad in a distinct
watery film.

forms.name: Royal Waterclaw
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Royal Claw</COL>.

forms.name: Gigas Club
forms.text:
A blunt weapon whose heavy
blows strike harder than
most Swords.

forms.name: Gigas Crusher
forms.text:
Nothing gets in the way of
the Gigas Club's final form.
Absolutely nothing.

forms.name: Mighty Gigantreon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Gigas Club</COL>.

forms.name: Rex Talon
forms.text:
Modeled after a Tigrex claw.
One swing pulverizes the
enemy with an enormous roar.

forms.name: Tigrex Sword
forms.text:
The Rex Talon's final form.
Able to seize the souls of pitiful
foes in one fell swoop.

forms.name: Great Tigrex Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rex Talon</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Tabar
forms.text:
A small, portable axe
designed to be used in a
continuous hacking motion.

forms.name: Ragdos Tabar
forms.text:
A nice, hard swing goes a
long way with the Bone
Tabar's final form.

forms.name: Bonebreaker Tabar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Tabar</COL>.

forms.name: Brash Buddies
forms.text:
Mix a Bullfango tusk with a
Rhenoplos Shell and you get
quite the dynamic duo.

forms.name: Cocky Comrades
forms.text:
The Brash Buddies's final
form employs a blade that's
most tempestuous.

forms.name: Cocksure Compatriots
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Brash Buddies</COL>.

forms.name: Poison Axe
forms.text:
This weapon's bone blade is
soaked in the toxins of
poisonous monster organs.

forms.name: Poison Battleaxe
forms.text:
One slash from the Poison
Axe's final form is enough
to send its foes to the abyss.

forms.name: Strong Poison Battleaxe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Poison Axe</COL>.

forms.name: Lagia Sword
forms.text:
A Thunder Sword. Through
its blade flows lightning
that multiplies the pain.

forms.name: High Lagia Sword
forms.text:
The Lagia Sword's final form.
Harnesses the power of the
storm with every strike.

forms.name: Exlagia Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Lagia Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Storm Sword
forms.text:
An azure Sword charged with
Thunder; its bearer becomes
a raging maelstrom.

forms.name: Takemikazuchi
forms.text:
The final form of the Storm
Sword rules the seas with a
thunderous fist.

forms.name: Susanoo-no-Mikoto
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Storm Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Sharkutter
forms.text:
A Sword that uses Zamtrios
hide in its blade. The supple
Shield deflects heavy blows.

forms.name: Sharkgutter
forms.text:
The Sharkutter's final form.
The shield admirably wards
off Wyvern attacks.

forms.name: Sharkslitter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sharkutter</COL>.

forms.name: Sharfin Sword
forms.text:
An advanced Sword with a
tougher blade. Icy sharpness
exudes beauty and power.

forms.name: Sharfinisher
forms.text:
The Sharfin Sword's final
form features a blade that's
equally sharp and chilling.

forms.name: Icy Akzar
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sharfin Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Bone Pick
forms.text:
Made of high quality monster
spine, it is as rough and
powerful as it looks.

forms.name: Osteon Pick
forms.text:
The Bone Pick's final form can
make fine sport out of any
Wyvern.

forms.name: Spinal Pick
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bone Pick</COL>.

forms.name: Thunderbane
forms.text:
A special Sword that gets
its electrical charge from
a Khezu organ.

forms.name: Frightbane
forms.text:
Unlucky prey can expect
nasty shocks from the
Thunderbane's final form.

forms.name: Indra
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunderbane</COL>.

forms.name: Weary Finsword
forms.text:
A blade forged with Plesioth
Fins that puts its targets
into a deep slumber.

forms.name: Sandman Finsword
forms.text:
The Weary Finsword's final
form compels prey to sleep
for all eternity.

forms.name: Phobetor Finsword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Weary Finsword</COL>.

forms.name: Rajang Club
forms.text:
A club-like Sword made to
release thunder. When danger
lurks, thunder strikes.

forms.name: Banned Rajang Club
forms.text:
The Rajang Club's final
form inspires ceaseless
rage inside the wielder.

forms.name: Cursed Rajang Club
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Rajang Club</COL>.

forms.name: Demonlord Mace
forms.text:
A devilish-looking Sword &
Shield for those already on
the warpath.

forms.name: Demonlord Bludgeon
forms.text:
The Demonlord Mace's final
form seeks only one thing:
pure, unrelenting carnage.

forms.name: Demonlord Crusher
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Demonlord Mace</COL>.

forms.name: Studded Club
forms.text:
A weapon made from hard Diablos
horn and studded with fangs.
High Attack power.

forms.name: Spiked Bat
forms.text:
The Studded Club's final form.
Strength and toughness meld
perfectly in this inimitable set.

forms.name: Barbarian Terror
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Studded Club</COL>.

forms.name: Djinn
forms.text:
A Sword with a red-hot blade
wrapped in the scorching
flames of a wyvern.

forms.name: Blazing Falchion
forms.text:
The final form of the
Djinn, made from incendiary
materials. As hot as magma.

forms.name: High Ifrit
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Djinn</COL>.

forms.name: Corona
forms.text:
A Sword cloaked in mighty flames.
Though its base Attack is low,
its Fire power is formidable.

forms.name: Daze Eye
forms.text:
One swing of the Corona's
final form can scorch
the earth around it.

forms.name: Suncore
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Corona</COL>.

forms.name: Golden Falchion
forms.text:
A Sword made from golden wyvern
scales. A similar weapon lies
in the tomb of an ancient king.

forms.name: Golden Radius
forms.text:
The Golden Falchion's final
form. Its flames wantonly
fry any and everything.

forms.name: Golden Riot
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Golden Falchion</COL>.

forms.name: Platinum Dawn
forms.text:
An ancient, light-bringing
Sword & Shield blessed by the
Gold Queen and Silver King.

forms.name: Annular Sol
forms.text:
The Platinum Dawn's final form.
Its brilliant blade chases away
the deepest darknesses.

forms.name: Daybreak Sun
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Platinum Dawn</COL>.

forms.name: Flame Syphos
forms.text:
A flaming Sword mantled in
dark rage. As massive and
weighty as a volcano lord.

forms.name: Black Doom Flame
forms.text:
Flame Syphos's final form. Its attacks
create wild flame, and the heavy
shield offers superior protection.

forms.name: Red Divine Flame
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Flame Syphos</COL>.

forms.name: Binding Blade
forms.text:
Crafted by popular demand,
this is the ultimate binding
sword with G-rank power.

forms.name: Great Kris
forms.text:
The Binding Blade's final form.
Hundreds of hours of painstaking
research led to its creation.

forms.name: Bloodsucker
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Binding Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Secta Nulo
forms.text:
A Sword carved from Bnahabra
parts. Its feather pattern is
both stylish and sharp.

forms.name: Secta Unu
forms.text:
The Secta Nulo's final
form is plenty sharp, both
literally and figuratively.

forms.name: Secta Du
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Secta Nulo</COL>.

forms.name: Secta Nulo (G)
forms.text:
A Sword carved from Bnahabra
parts. Its emerald blade can
paralyze and immobilize foes.

forms.name: Secta Unu (G)
forms.text:
The Secta Nulo (G)'s final
form. Its emerald blade robs
its prey of its senses.

forms.name: Secta Du (G)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Secta Nulo (G)</COL>.

forms.name: Secta Nulo (R)
forms.text:
A blade made from Bnahabra
parts that flickers with a
brilliant rouge hue.

forms.name: Secta Unu (R)
forms.text:
The Secta Nulo (R)'s final
form. Flames dance in the
wake of every swing.

forms.name: Secta Du (R)
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Secta Nulo (R)</COL>.

forms.name: Celestial Sword
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made by
layering hard materials and
then plating them. Heavy.

forms.name: Celestial Brand
forms.text:
Only the real deal can lift
the weighty Celestial
Sword's final form.

forms.name: Empyreal Brand
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Celestial Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Cross Sword
forms.text:
A quality product that adds
more layers for rigidity.
Has a satisfying heft.

forms.name: Dual Cross Brand
forms.text:
The Cross Sword's final form
compromises on neither
offense nor defense.

forms.name: Grand Dual Cross
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cross Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Scaly Sword
forms.text:
A carefully carved Nerscylla
claw. The strength in its
slender edge defies logic.

forms.name: Nerskiller
forms.text:
The Scaly Sword's final form.
This flexible Sword can slip through
the tiniest cracks in a shell.

forms.name: Shadow Nerwrithe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Scaly Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Bloodscale Sword
forms.text:
A Sword made of stronger
Nerscylla parts. The Shield
gem seems to size up prey.

forms.name: Bloodsquama Sword
forms.text:
The Bloodscale Sword's final form.
The secrets of its creation make
the blade seem bloodstained.

forms.name: Bloodslaughter
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Bloodscale Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Cutter
forms.text:
A forestry cutter, typical of
Yukumo, repurposed into a
hunting Sword.

forms.name: Yukumo Hatchet
forms.text:
The Yukumo Cutter's final
form. Fells trees with swift-
swinging ease.

forms.name: Hot Spring Hatchet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Cutter</COL>.

forms.name: Yukumo Pure Cutter
forms.text:
The Yukumo Cutter the way
it was meant to be made.
Superior in every way.

forms.name: Divine Yukumo Axe
forms.text:
There's nothing the final
form of the Yukumo's Pure
Cutter can't chop down.

forms.name: Spiritual Yukumo Axe
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Yukumo Pure Cutter</COL>.

forms.name: Tusk Gear
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield that just so
happen to resemble a wyvern's
head when matched. Hmm...

forms.name: Skull's Wrath
forms.text:
The Tusk Gear's final
form, bearer of myriad
memories dating back eons.

forms.name: Chalcamine Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tusk Gear</COL>.

forms.name: Catspaw
forms.text:
A Melynx's beloved thieving
tool. Gather stamps and
buy from a Lynian.

forms.name: Catburglar
forms.text:
The Catspaw's final form.
"Meow, meow meow meow."
-A famed Melynx

forms.name: Catlike Tread
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Catspaw</COL>.

forms.name: Melynx Tool
forms.text:
A Melynx's favorite club.
Simply holding it will make
thievery second nature.

forms.name: Melynx Gadget
forms.text:
With the final Melynx
Tool, the world is your
oyster, ripe for stealing!

forms.name: Melynx Master
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Melynx Tool</COL>.

forms.name: Kitchen Knife
forms.text:
The heart and soul of any
real chef. The kitchen has
no place for good or evil!

forms.name: Iron Chefblade
forms.text:
The Kitchen Knife's final
form. Stands up to even the
biggest meals.

forms.name: Millennium Knife
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kitchen Knife</COL>.

forms.name: Chak Chak
forms.text:
A weapon often used by foreign
hunters. Notable for its strange
shape and colors.

forms.name: Wagga Wagga
forms.text:
The Chak Chak's final
form, forged with exotic,
yet powerful techniques.

forms.name: Gimble Gyre
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Chak Chak</COL>.

forms.name: Moofah Sword
forms.text:
This Sword & Shield uses
all parts of the fluffy
Moofah to great effect.

forms.name: Sleepy Moofah
forms.text:
Tuck in to a good night's
sleep with the Moofah
Sword's final form.

forms.name: Sound Asleep Moofah
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Moofah Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Eldora Closure
forms.text:
A weapon made from precious
relics that the Meownster
Hunters discovered.

forms.name: Treasured Fedda
forms.text:
The Eldora Closure's final
form. Retains its radiance
even after so much use.

forms.name: Lost Ys
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eldora Closure</COL>.

forms.name: Hana no Nagoriwo
forms.text:
Elegant fans carried by
samurai with unbreakable
loyalty to their lords.

forms.name: Kurenawi Ougi
forms.text:
Any and all life scatters
to the wind with the Hana
no Nagoriwo's final form.

forms.name: Kurenawi Kunpuu
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hana no Nagoriwo</COL>.

forms.name: Verdant Rapier
forms.text:
Rain hell upon your enemies
with this Sword & Shield made
from Astalos materials.

forms.name: Lightning Rapier
forms.text:
The Verdant Rapier's final
form. All shalt be humbled
before its might.

forms.name: Astalos Rapier
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Verdant Rapier</COL>.

forms.name: Giant's Tusk
forms.text:
The Gammoth tusk on this
blade can make pebbles of
the biggest boulders.

forms.name: Colossus's Tusk
forms.text:
The Giant's Tusk's final
form. The blade you turn to
when hunting gods.

forms.name: Behemoth's Tusk
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Giant's Tusk</COL>.

forms.name: Burning Prominar
forms.text:
A Sword whose wavy design
design is meant to evoke
the Glavenus' flames.

forms.name: Glinting Glavenus
forms.text:
The Burning Prominar's final
form. A weapon whose power
can darken the sky.

forms.name: Glinting Glavenova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Burning Prominar</COL>.

forms.name: Sucher-Ankh
forms.text:
A black Sword incredibly
heavy for its size. Its
eye is a window to hell.

forms.name: Jäger-Ankh
forms.text:
The eye on the Sucher-Ankh's
final form compels one to fling
themselves into the abyss.

forms.name: Sieger-Ankh
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Sucher-Ankh</COL>.

forms.name: Le Détecteur
forms.text:
An incredibly light dagger.
With its iridescent Shield,
it makes mighty heroes.

forms.name: La Vérité
forms.text:
The Le Détecteur's final
form is the centerpiece of
spectral sword dances.

forms.name: Le Limier
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Le Détecteur</COL>.

forms.name: Kirin Bolt Ultimus
forms.text:
Made from the rumored Kirin.
A weapon that can unleash
the power of lightning.

forms.name: Kirin Bolt Maximus
forms.text:
The Kirin Bolt Ultimus's final
form brands the owner as a
godly messenger.

forms.name: Kirin Bolt Perfectus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kirin Bolt Ultimus</COL>.

forms.name: Skeletal Blade
forms.text:
A ghastly Sword & Shield
that defies fate itself in
favor of pure chaos.

forms.name: Infernal Horns
forms.text:
The Skeletal Blade's final
form. Plant the seeds of revenge
in the brows of your enemy.

forms.name: Aldebaran Horns
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Skeletal Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Astral Taurus
forms.text:
Bona fide proof of one who
can go forth and guide
celestial bodies.

forms.name: Enraged Taurus
forms.text:
The Astral Taurus's final
form. Contains the darkness
of the cosmos in every swing.

forms.name: Wrathful Taurus
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Astral Taurus</COL>.

forms.name: Floral Seif
forms.text:
An elegant blade full of
passion that goes well with
most any dress.

forms.name: Blooming Seif
forms.text:
The Floral Seif's final
form, sublime in both form
and function.

forms.name: Garlanded Seif
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Floral Seif</COL>.

forms.name: Black Belt Sword
forms.text:
Only those who have come
out on top in the Arena
are allowed to wield this.

forms.name: Shihan Sword
forms.text:
The Black Belt Sword's final
form epitomizes all your blood,
sweat, and tears.

forms.name: Grandmaster Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Belt Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Black Sword
forms.text:
A Sword with dark power
within. The void it creates
envelopes all in its path.

forms.name: Chrono Sword
forms.text:
The Black Sword's final
form, a blade enveloping
its victims in darkness.

forms.name: Fatalis Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Black Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Ninja Sword
forms.text:
Despite its short, thin
blade, this small sword is
useful for fighting wyverns.

forms.name: Hi Ninja Sword
forms.text:
The Ninja Sword's final
form. Can silently slay
a Wyvern with ease.

forms.name: Ninja Master Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ninja Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Research Sword
forms.text:
A weapon fit for a sleuth. The blade
serves as a magnifying glass, and
the shield doubles as a compass.

forms.name: Discovery Sword
forms.text:
The Research Sword's final form.
According to the sages, it points
the way to unlimited scholarship.

forms.name: Authority Pathfinder
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Research Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Inazuma Works
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield from a foreign
land. Lightning blasts from
its blade can cleave the earth.

forms.name: Ikazuchi Works
forms.text:
The Inazuma Works's final
form. The lightning harbored
within rends heaven from earth.

forms.name: Dengeki Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Inazuma Works</COL>.

forms.name: Levindicator
forms.text:
Contains a drake's power.
The golden beard summons
heaven-splitting lightning.

forms.name: CoroCoro Thunderbolt
forms.text:
The Levindicator's final form.
A black dragon blade that calls
thunder forth from the heavens.

forms.name: Rolling Thunderbolt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Levindicator</COL>.

forms.name: Hero's Sword
forms.text:
The Hero of Hyrule's Sword.
Its sacred power cannot be
touched by wicked hands.

forms.name: Master Sword
forms.text:
The final form of the Hero's
Sword. Its sacred power can
seal evil and restore light.

forms.name: Master Sword G
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hero's Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Falchion
forms.text:
A legendary sword that, along
with the Sealing Shield, the
righteous wield in battle.

forms.name: Exalted Falchion
forms.text:
The final form of the Falchion
can seal the forces of evil and
restore harmony to the world.

forms.name: Illustrious Falchion
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of
the <COL FF0000FF>Falchion</COL>.

forms.name: Akantor Duo
forms.text:
A Sword hiding dark godly
powers that can forcibly
pave a new way.

forms.name: Akantor Coup
forms.text:
The Akantor Duo's final
form. Consumes all on its
path to destructive glory.

forms.name: Akantor Purge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Akantor Duo</COL>.

forms.name: Ukanlos Soul Hatchet
forms.text:
The embodiment of the white god's
third power: its yell. Strong
enough to bring down the sun.

forms.name: Ukanlos Skyhatchet
forms.text:
The Ukanlos Soul Hatchet's
final form. Echoes the cries
of harvested souls.

forms.name: Ukanlos Earth Hatchet
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ukanlos Soul Hatchet</COL>.

forms.name: Ominous Treasure
forms.text:
A Sword possessed by a
heavenly spirit, bequeathed
with great power.

forms.name: Heavenly Gale
forms.text:
The Ominous Treasure's final
form. An avatar of the cycle of
life and death.

forms.name: Heaven and Earth
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ominous Treasure</COL>.

forms.name: Alatreon Sword
forms.text:
A sword made from Alatreon
materials. They say its holder
can hear a mysterious voice...

forms.name: Alatreon Star
forms.text:
The Alatreon Sword's final
form. Its formless voice
lures warriors to darkness.

forms.name: Altheos Zodiarch
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Alatreon Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Silverwing Swiftblade
forms.text:
The Argent Comet's Sword is
silent and patient as the stars,
glittering as fiercely as starfire.

forms.name: Dragonstar Alcor
Magnastar Akri
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Silverwing Swiftblade</COL>.

forms.name: Elder Sword
forms.text:
A Sword from the Soaratorium
for hunters breaking new ground.
Tough and flexible in equal measure.

forms.name: Sage Sword
forms.text:
The Elder Sword's final form. It's
light, but capable of dealing
devastating attacks.

forms.name: Philosopher Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elder Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Wycademy Dagger
forms.text:
A blade that opens doors to
wisdom that perseverance alone
cannot unlock.

forms.name: Insignia Dagger
forms.text:
The Wycademy Dagger's final
form. Furthers the path towards
unlimited intelligence.

forms.name: Ravilian Insignia
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Wycademy Dagger</COL>.

forms.name: Xin's Trust
forms.text:
A sword inherited by a
would-be general, and a
shield that stirs passion.

forms.name: Xin's Faith
forms.text:
Xin's Trust's final form.
Believe in its true worth,
and it shall be so.

forms.name: Xin's Virtue
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of
<COL FF0000FF>Xin's Trust</COL>.

forms.name: Verstecken/Chercher
forms.text:
A black Sword whose Affinity
changes when its wielder
overcomes the Frenzy.

forms.name: Entkommen/Trouver
forms.text:
The Verstecken/Chercher's final
form. Shows its true potential only
to those who would serve truth.

forms.name: Lügen/Vérité
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Verstecken/Chercher</COL>.

forms.name: Goldsword
forms.text:
Golden relic of a lost civilization.
The inscription tells of a king who
brutally oppressed his people.

forms.name: Inscribed Ausir
forms.text:
The Goldsword's final form.
Possibly god-made, its forging
remains a mystery.

forms.name: Unnefer
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Goldsword</COL>.

forms.name: Ruiner Sword
forms.text:
A Sword that dispels darkness.
Said to vibrate at the sound
of a Dragon's roar.

forms.name: True Ruiner Sword
forms.text:
The final form of the Ruiner Sword,
slayer of thousands of dragons.
Will sever even vengeance.

forms.name: Absolute Ruiner Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Ruiner Sword</COL>.

forms.name: O. Fatalis Sword
forms.text:
An accursed Sword from an
old Fatalis. Its wielder must
dance its dance until death.

forms.name: True O. Fatalis Sword
forms.text:
The final form of the O. Fatalis
Sword. Only those who've broken
the Fatalis curse may wield it.

forms.name: Pure O. Fatalis Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>O. Fatalis Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Rapier
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Dreadqueen parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Rapier Rose
forms.text:
The Dreadqueen Rapier's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadqueen Rathian.

forms.name: Dreadqueen Rapierina
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dreadqueen Rapier</COL>!

forms.name: Drilltusk Truncheon
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Drilltusk parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Official Truncheon
forms.text:
The Drilltusk Truncheon's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Drilltusk Tetsucabra.

forms.name: Constable's Truncheon
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Drilltusk Truncheon</COL>!

forms.name: Nightfall Edge
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Silverwind parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Silverwind Edge
forms.text:
The Nightfall Edge's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Silverwind Nargacuga.

forms.name: Daybreak Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Nightfall Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Geode Mace
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Crystalbeard parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Crystalbeard Mace
forms.text:
The Geode Mace's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Crystalbeard Uragaan.

forms.name: Diamante Mace
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Geode Mace</COL>!

forms.name: Hardened Edge
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Deadeye parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Deadeye Edge
forms.text:
The Hardened Edge's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Deadeye Yian Garuga.

forms.name: Deadeye Fiasco
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hardened Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Tomb Edge
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Dreadking parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Dreadking Edge
forms.text:
The Tomb Edge's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Dreadking Rathalos.

forms.name: Firewaltz Edge
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Tomb Edge</COL>!

forms.name: Thunderlord Firebolt
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Thunderlord parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Thunderlord Crookbolt
forms.text:
The Thunderlord Firebolt's final
form. Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Thunderlord Zinogre.

forms.name: Thunderlord Skybolt
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Thunderlord Firebolt</COL>!

forms.name: Grimclaw Barb
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Grimclaw parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Grimclaw Glare
forms.text:
The Grimclaw Barb's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Grimclaw Tigrex.

forms.name: Grimclaw Spur
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Grimclaw Barb</COL>!

forms.name: Fiery Prominar
forms.text:
A Sword & Shield made from
Hellblade parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Magma Hellblade
forms.text:
The Fiery Prominar's final form.
Only for those who've tamed
the mighty Hellblade Glavenus.

forms.name: Magma Nova
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Fiery Prominar</COL>!

forms.name: Cloaked Fan
forms.text:
A Sword and Shield made of
Nightcloak parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Cloaked Schlaf
forms.text:
The Cloaked Fan's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Nightcloak Malfestio.

forms.name: Cloaked Dämmerschlaf
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Cloaked Fan</COL>!

forms.name: Razor Render
forms.text:
A Sword and Shield made of
Rustrazor parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Careless Render
forms.text:
The Razor Render's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Rustrazor Ceanataur.

forms.name: Rustrazor Render
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Razor Render</COL>!

forms.name: Kyoka Fugetsu
forms.text:
A Sword and Shield made of
Soulseer parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Tokaede
forms.text:
Kyoka Fugetsu's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Soulseer Mizutsune.

forms.name: Sanitsurau
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Kyoka Fugetsu</COL>!

forms.name: Zephra Rapier
forms.text:
A Sword and Shield made from
Boltreaver Astalos parts. Wielding
it fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Zephra Espada
forms.text:
The Zephyr Rapier's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Boltreaver Astalos.

forms.name: Zilvolt Espada
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Zephra Rapier</COL>!

forms.name: Elderfrost Sword
forms.text:
A Sword and Shield made of
Elderfrost parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Elderfrost Opposer
forms.text:
The Elderfrost Sword's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Elderfrost Gammoth.

forms.name: Elderfrost Giant Slalom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Elderfrost Sword</COL>!

forms.name: Massacre Club
forms.text:
A Sword and Shield made from
Bloodbath parts. Wielding it
fills the Arts Gauge faster.

forms.name: Massacre Bludgeon
forms.text:
The Massacre Club's final form.
Only for those who've tamed the
mighty Bloodbath Diablos.

forms.name: Kristatu
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
Behold the Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Massacre Club</COL>!

forms.name: Rusted Sword
forms.text:
A rusted Sword with
unrealized potential. It
could perhaps be polished...

forms.name: Tarnished Sword
forms.text:
The Rusted Sword's final
form. Its corrosive power
is a mystery much like its history.

forms.name: Eternal Strife
forms.text:
The ultimate dragon slayer,
this Sword was hammered by
blacksmiths for 108 days.

forms.name: Eternal Hate
forms.text:
The Eternal Strife's final
form brings the distant past
back to the forefront.

forms.name: Eternal Vengeance
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Eternal Strife</COL>.

forms.name: Icesteel Dagger
forms.text:
Sword & Shield holding the
power of Daora. Used by the
icy kings of northern lands.

forms.name: Daora's Razor
forms.text:
The Icesteel Dagger's final form
is capable of blizzard-like
strikes with every swing.

forms.name: Daora's Maelstrom
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Icesteel Dagger</COL>.

forms.name: Worn Sword
forms.text:
A worn Sword with unrealized
potential. It could perhaps be
restored...

forms.name: Weathered Sword
forms.text:
The Worn Sword's final
form, the powerful result of a
life free from repairs.

forms.name: Aged Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Worn Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Divine Exodus
forms.text:
A strange Sword. They say
the polished Shield shows
one's future self...

forms.name: Divine Insodus
forms.text:
The Divine Exodus's final
evolution. Its shield reflects
its owner's fate.

forms.name: Divine Egression
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Divine Exodus</COL>.

forms.name: Teostra's Spada
forms.text:
The Flame Emperor's burning
sigil. At the king of beasts'
behest, the gates of hell open.

forms.name: Teostra's Emblem
forms.text:
The shield of the final iteration
of the Teostra's Spada bears
the head of a proud beast.

forms.name: Teostra's Medal
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Teostra's Spada</COL>.

forms.name: Hero's Blade
forms.text:
The sword of Kokoto's hero.
Think you can actually
fill such big shoes!?

forms.name: Master's Blade
forms.text:
The Hero's Blade's final
form. Turns out you had
it in ya after all!

forms.name: Legend's Blade
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Hero's Blade</COL>.

forms.name: Dragonseal Sword
forms.text:
An ancient sword affixed to
a Dragon Fossil that was
excavated in a mine.

forms.name: Dragontruth Sword
forms.text:
The Dragonseal Sword's final
form. Draws out the wielder's
true potential in battle.

forms.name: Dragonzenith Sword
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Dragonseal Sword</COL>.

forms.name: Shining Wyvern Blade
forms.text:
Made from legendary Gold
Rathian and Silver Rathalos
materials. Incredible power.

forms.name: Shining Wyvernstruth
forms.text:
The Shining Wyvern Blade's
final form. The power of the
sun and moon in one.

forms.name: Shining Wyvernzenith
forms.text:
<CNTR><COL FF0000FF>== Ultimate Form ==</COL>
The coveted Ultimate Form of the
<COL FF0000FF>Shining Wyvern Blade</COL>.
